name: Keranos
description: God of storms and insight on Theros, embodying lightning and sudden inspiration; impatient, indifferent to morality.

description_citations.text: "Keranos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cymede offers herself to Keranos, who turns the Deyda River into an elemental that consumes the minotaurs; she ascends to Nyx.
timeline.quote: Cymede was claimed by Keranos as she transformed into a pillar of fire and crimson light and ascended into Nyx

citation.text: "Akros", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Keranos circumvents the Silence of the Gods by sending prophetic visions to Queen Cymede, helping her destroy the minotaur army of Rhordon with a steam elemental.
timeline.quote: he circumvented the Silence by sending prophetic visions to Queen Cymede

citation.text: "Keranos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As a reward for her faith, Keranos takes Cymede from Akros shortly before the Great Revel.
timeline.quote: Keranos took her from Akros shortly before the Great Revel
